purpose: Declared before live generation; these expectations are review criteria, not a semantic pass based on keyword matching.
scope: Synthetic equipment-library documents, distinct from the risk-profiling development corpus.
checks: Borrowing normally requires both active membership and no unpaid overdue charge.
Staff exception waives only the charge requirement, not membership and not the recorded charge.
Collection requires the linked identity check; failure does not establish fraud.
Reservation hold expires 48 hours after confirmation; indefinite history retention is not invented.
One unavailable item does not cancel other reservations and must not be substituted automatically.
Evening collection remains an unapproved proposal, not available service.
Extension request alone does not change the original due date.
Name mismatch requires review, not automatic acceptance or permanent rejection.
Delegated collector needs both authorization and their own unexpired document.
Document image is not stored; check outcome and reviewer reference are retained.
Identity-service timeout permits one retry but does not extend the reservation hold.
Incomplete check cannot authorize collection; complete result is not by itself sufficient.
One seven-day extension requires absence of a conflicting subsequent reservation.
Rejected extension leaves original due date unchanged.
Missing accessory follow-up and damage maintenance review are independent.
Two-location return pilot applies to tools, not automatically to audio equipment.
Both conflicting unclaimed-property periods are retained without invented precedence.
mechanical_requirements: No planned section is silently dropped by the pipeline.
No internal paragraph index is presented as a customer-facing section number.
No raw auditor explanation or AI-production disclaimer is appended to customer prose.
Every final citation resolves to an exact excerpt and frozen source context.
Repair and audit records use actual stable paragraph IDs.
Unsupported generated claims are repaired or replaced by relevant exact source text; original draft is preserved for inspection.
